subject: Milestone-triggered retainer reclamation protocol / credit memo timeline
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bluebridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Bluebridge Finance <finance@bluebridge.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Milestone-triggered retainer reclamation protocol — request for ops playbook

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this — quick context: our contract with Redwood includes a $600k annual retainer tied to 3 product milestones. We finished milestone 1 and 2, but milestone 3 will not be achieved this fiscal year due to scope changes. Finance has asked for a clean ops playbook from Redwood that outlines how unused retainer is reclaimed or credited back, how credit memos are issued, and the VAT/tax evidence you need from us.

Can you confirm the following items so we can map to our month-end close:  
- Standard credit memo lead time (days) and whether Redwood issues a credit or invoice adjustment
- Template line items you need (PO ref, deal id, original invoice numbers)
- VAT handling (do we need to provide tax residency certificate or is the PO enough?)
- Any bank remittance / entity routing that impacts VAT treatment

Attachments: bluebridge_milestone_summary.csv (summary of milestone spend), PO_4521.pdf

We'd like a short mutual action plan and timeline for when finance can expect a credit memo or refund. If you can copy the credit memo sample and a one-page checklist for VAT evidence that would help us route internally.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
VP, Finance — Bluebridge
[Attachment: bluebridge_milestone_summary.csv (text/csv), PO_4521.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bluebridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Milestone-triggered retainer reclamation protocol — request for ops playbook

Elena — great overview, and thank you for the attachments. High level answer up front: we can issue a credit memo tied to the retained advance; we typically process credit memos within 10–15 business days after confirmation of the reclaimable amount and receipt of required tax evidence. Below is a proposed 4-step mutual action plan (MAP) and the documents we will produce: 

Proposed MAP (timeline from your approval):
1) Confirm reclaimable amount (2 business days): Redwood to reconcile milestone usage vs. contracted retainer and provide a reconciliation worksheet back to Bluebridge (we'll use your attached CSV).
2) Approval & VAT evidence (3 business days): Bluebridge to confirm reclaimable amount and send VAT docs we need (see checklist).
3) Credit memo issuance (10 business days): Redwood issues credit memo referencing original invoice numbers and your PO; credit memo delivered as PDF and posted to the billing portal.
4) Ledger posting / bank routing (3 business days after credit memo): Finance teams complete cash movement or AR adjustments.

What we'll send (samples attached):
- reconciliation_workbook.csv (recon of used vs unused retainer)
- sample_creditmemo.xlsx (template credit memo with line-item mapping)
- VAT_evidence_checklist.pdf (one-page list of docs)

Specific asks for Bluebridge finance:
- Confirm PO number (I have PO_4521, confirm correct entity)
- Provide tax residency certificate or exemption docs if your invoices are zero-rated cross-border (we can accept PDF or a signed statement)
- Confirm desired treatment: credit memo to ledger (preferred) or refund to bank account (we need remit instructions if refund)

Related links: https://hubspot.example/deal/BB-2026-4521 — I'll attach the sample files to that record so CS/finance have a single view.

If this MAP looks good I can kick off the reconciliation now and Kimberly will own the credit memo issuance once numbers are final.

— Jonas Weber
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: reconciliation_workbook.csv, sample_creditmemo.xlsx, VAT_evidence_checklist.pdf]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Milestone-triggered retainer reclamation protocol — operational checklist

Looping in some ops detail I want on the record before we send the MAP to Bluebridge. Quick notes:  

- Ledger cutoffs: credit memos processed before Redwood's monthly AR close (cutoff is the 20th) will be included in the same month; after that they hit next month's close — call this out to the customer.
- Credit memo fields we must populate: original invoice date, invoice #, PO ref, contract line id, reclaimable_amount (currency), VAT_amount (if applicable), final_balance_after_credit.
- Tax jurisdiction: if Bluebridge is EU-based or has an EU VAT id, we need a stamped tax residency or VAT registration document. For US entities a W-9 or equivalent vendor tax form is helpful.
- Refunds: if they request a bank refund instead of ledger credit, we need a signed remit form + beneficiary banking details; refunds go through finance and take 7–10 business days after approval.
- Attachments I'll provide: sample_creditmemo.xlsx, creditmemo_generation_runbook.md (short runbook), and internal ticket template for AR ops.

Quoting Jonas for a line:
> "We can issue a credit memo tied to the retained advance; we typically process credit memos within 10–15 business days after confirmation of the reclaimable amount and receipt of required tax evidence."

Kim — please confirm PO_4521 entity mapping (the CSV shows two sub-entities) and whether we should split the credit memo or issue a single combined credit. Once confirmed I'll prepare the credit memo draft and route to Elena + finance@bluebridge.com.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample_creditmemo.xlsx, creditmemo_generation_runbook.md]
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bluebridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Bluebridge Finance <finance@bluebridge.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 08:50:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Milestone-triggered retainer reclamation protocol — acceptance & timelines

Thanks Jonas and Kim — that map is fine with us. Two small clarifications before you proceed:  
1) Please issue a single combined credit memo to cover the unused portion (we'll apply internally across the sub-entities)
2) For VAT evidence we will attach our tax residency certificate (will send) — can you confirm if you need the original stamped PDF or if a signed electronic copy is acceptable?

Bank routing / refund: we prefer a credit to ledger rather than a refund. If a refund is required for any reason later, route to finance@bluebridge.com and we'll provide remit details.

Please proceed with the reconciliation worksheet and send the draft credit memo to finance@bluebridge.com and cc me. Target: credit memo issued by 2026-09-07 (that timing fits our month-end close on the 15th).

Attaching a short remit file with our entity and AR contact for your records.

Regards,
Elena Morales
VP, Finance — Bluebridge
[Attachment: remit_instructions.txt (text/plain)]
